rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CIX. Of the Wit or Understanding of the Native
rules.meaning_historical_only: Separate printed CHAP CIX/editorial CX opens after the planetary-manners chapter on the same page.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury and his configuration with the Moon
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly uses Mercury as the rational-soul/intellect significator and Moon as the vegetative/strength-of-brain counterpart; this is premodern physiology, not neuroscience.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: well affected ... mutually aspect ... good aspect
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury and Moon in well-supported houses/signs and in a favorable mutual aspect are alleged to indicate strong understanding.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: ill affected ... Square or Opposition ... no aspect
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly groups unfavorable conditions, hard mutual aspects and absent aspect as indicators of dull cognition; retain the competing alternative triggers, not an averaged claim.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: By well mixing the significations, a mediocrity
rules.meaning_historical_only: Intermediate judgments require combining multiple testimonies rather than a simple binary Mercury–Moon scoring switch.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury be more strong then Moon
rules.meaning_historical_only: When Mercury is stronger and in commanding/long-ascension signs versus Moon in obedient/short-ascension signs, Lilly says reason masters passion.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: If Moon ... more strong then Mercury ... affections
rules.meaning_historical_only: When Moon is stronger, emotion or other faculties are alleged to override reason; the sentence finishes on the following original page.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury and Moon in conjunction in any signe
rules.meaning_historical_only: A Mercury–Moon conjunction is alleged to signify ingenious understanding in any zodiac sign.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sextile or in Trine ... Sextile is preferred
rules.meaning_historical_only: Both sextile and trine are classed favorable, with the sextile explicitly preferred over the trine in this historical passage.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: The Square aspect ... Wit enough not so sober
rules.meaning_historical_only: The square is not portrayed simply as zero wit; Lilly concedes sufficient wit while describing a rougher imagination.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Opposition ... in angles ... stubborn and turbulent
rules.meaning_historical_only: For an opposition of Mercury and Moon occurring in angles, Lilly assigns stubborn or turbulent thought and action.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: if either of them be in his Detriment
rules.meaning_historical_only: The angular-opposition branch further intensifies derogatory character descriptions when either planet is in detriment.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury in Taurus Retrograde or Combust ... Capricorn in the twelfth house
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly alleges impaired understanding for the specified Taurus retrograde/combust and twelfth-house Capricorn Mercury combinations, especially with partial malefic affliction, even despite a lunar aspect.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury in Aquarius no way impedited ... Swift, Orientall
rules.meaning_historical_only: Unimpeded swift oriental Mercury in Aquarius, in a good house and with the north node, is alleged to confer learning and inventions.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury in either of his owne houses
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury in either domicile is said to sharpen understanding.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury received of the Moon by house or Exaltation
rules.meaning_historical_only: Reception of Mercury by Moon via domicile or exaltation is alleged to indicate imagination.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: most of the Planets are in ayery Signes
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly adds an aggregate airy-sign condition for intellectual ability; it is not a Mercury-only rule.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury in Aries with reception by Mars
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury in Aries received by Mars is said to confer a penetrating wit.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon with North Node or South Node
rules.meaning_historical_only: Moon with either lunar node is alleged to support active learning; do not silently change 'or' into 'and'.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: best ... increases in light ... not far from the full
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly makes the node/moon claim strongest for Moon waxing near full.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: under the earth and in no aspect ... mind ... Arts
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury below the horizon with no planetary aspects is alleged to incline toward practical arts.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: above the earth ... incites to Oratory
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury above the horizon is distinguished as favoring oratory.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: very swift in motion ... inconstant ... quick of apprehension
rules.meaning_historical_only: Swift Mercury allegedly gives changeable opinions yet quick comprehension; both valences must be preserved.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Retrograde or slow ... stuttering companions
rules.meaning_historical_only: Retrograde/slow Mercury is historically tied to alleged cognitive or speech deficits; unverified and stigmatizing.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Combust, or under the Sun-beames ... impertinent matters
rules.meaning_historical_only: Combust/under-beams Mercury is alleged to favor trivial pursuits instead of suitable inquiry.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: when Orientall ... liberall ... Occidentall a dissembler
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly differentiates oriental from occidental Mercury but this is a historical stereotype, not a real person's trustworthiness.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Planet who governeth the place where Mercury is ... great force
rules.meaning_historical_only: The dispositor's condition may change or override Mercury's stated influence; no isolated Mercury-orientation verdict.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: not afflicted ... of Mars ... well placed ... ayery Signe ... Aquarius
rules.meaning_historical_only: Unimpeded Mercury particularly in Aquarius, well placed and with either lunar node, is alleged to indicate acute language learning.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: in any angle ... one of his owne houses ... any Signe but Pisces and Scorpio
rules.meaning_historical_only: Angular Mercury, especially at Ascendant, with domicile and sign exclusion qualifications, is said to suit employment; preserve the source's unusual conjunction of criteria.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: upon the cusp of the ascendant ... ayery ... swift
rules.meaning_historical_only: Swift Mercury on an airy Ascendant cusp is said to confer memory/understanding while remaining mutable; record both sides.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury with Saturn ... wary ... constant
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury–Saturn is alleged to favor caution, perseverance and memory, with no independent cognitive corroboration.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury with Jupiter ... honest, learned ... humanity
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury–Jupiter is alleged to confer learning, judgment and humane conduct.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury with Mars ... confident and presumptuous
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury–Mars is described as confident as well as presumptuous; not a generic 'good Mars' or 'bad Mars' switch.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: With the Sun ambitious, arrogant and proud
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury–Sun is assigned ambition and negative pride-related traits in the historical account.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: With Venus more eloquent and lovesome
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury–Venus is alleged to confer eloquence and affection.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: With the Moon more unstable
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury–Moon appears again as a conditional mixture said to increase instability, despite earlier favorable Mercury–Moon configurations.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn helps the memory; Jupiter introduces honesty
rules.meaning_historical_only: The author explicitly repeats Saturn/memory and Jupiter/humanity as cross-planet qualifications rather than an independent experiment.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury Peregrine, Cadent ... Combust, slow ... afflicted
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly combines debility, house cadency, combustion, slow movement and partial malefic affliction in a purported cognitive-impairment rubric.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: especially of Mars ... more Mercury is afflicted
rules.meaning_historical_only: Severity allegedly scales with Mercury's malefic affliction, particularly Mars; this is not an evidence-based mental health rule.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury separated from the Moon ... in no aspect
rules.meaning_historical_only: Mercury separated from Moon with no aspect is separately alleged to imply weak understanding; interaction with earlier aspects remains unresolved.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: under the Sun beames ... also Retrograde
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly jointly links solar beams and retrograde Mercury to slowness of action or invention.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury in watry Signes ... without the aspect of one of the Fortunes
rules.meaning_historical_only: The source uses a derogatory intellectual-disability slur for Mercury in water signs lacking benefic aspect; do not turn this into a modern diagnostic or intelligence prediction.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: in those Signes Saturn afflict him ... impediment in his speech
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly separately claims Saturn's affliction in the watery-sign context denotes stuttering/speech impairment; this is unsupported as medicine.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury in Square of Mars, or in his Opposition
rules.meaning_historical_only: Square/opposition to Mars is linked to negative moral-character allegations, unsupported by independent evidence.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Phlegmatick Signes are enemies to study
rules.meaning_historical_only: Lilly historically associates phlegmatic signs with slow study.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: overplus of Melancholly ... very asses
rules.meaning_historical_only: An excess of melancholy receives an explicitly insulting cognitive description; record authorial language without endorsing it.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: men of Sanguine temperature seldome are permanent in studies
rules.meaning_historical_only: Sanguine temperament is alleged to impair sustained study, not necessarily inventiveness.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: neither doth the meer Cholerick man much love his study
rules.meaning_historical_only: Pure choleric temperament is said to prefer something other than prolonged study.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sanguine-melancholly man makes the best Student
rules.meaning_historical_only: Sanguine–melancholic mixture is singled out for study persistence.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.

rules.anchor_not_diplomatic: Cholerick-melanchollick men have excellent inventions
rules.meaning_historical_only: Choleric–melancholic mixture is singled out for inventive ability, not simply classroom study.
rules.source_limitation: Historical source assertion from 1647, not independent clinical, cognitive or social prediction.
